maya: Heads up — nightly eval (nightly-2026-03-19) flagged a bunch of tool/function-call failures for the new q4f model bring-up. Many errors are JSON parse failures when parsing function args. repro attached below.

maya: failing prompt set: `customer_support_contacts_v2` (30/200 failed) 
maya: sample failure: parser error on toolcall output in reranker pipeline.

eval-bot: nightly run summary: 200 tests, 32 failures, 14 toolcall/json errors, 8 tokenization drift, 10 other. CI job: nightly-eval/2026-03-19/1345.

jackie: can you paste the raw model output (not post-processed)? might be a stray char.

maya: raw model output (trimmed):
```
{"tool_call": {"name": "get_contacts"␞"args": {"user_id": "12345", "limit": 5}} 
```

maya: Note the separator between fields is U+241E SYMBOL FOR RECORD SEPARATOR (shown as ␞) instead of a comma. Parser fails with: `JSONDecodeError: Expecting ',' delimiter: line 1 column 31 (char 30)`

sandeep: ugh. which quant config did you use? q4f-only? any changes to tokenizer?

maya: model: rwd-bert-13b:q4f-pt (quantized with per-channel int4), tokenizer: default SentencePiece v0.1.

ai-runtime: we log raw token ids. pulling token sequence now.

ai-runtime: raw tokens (ids): [502, 34, 11, 2400, 425, 2, 241, 153, 24118, 24118, 7] — note tokens 241 and 24118 correspond to control-symbol outputs from our decode map (related to record sep).

sandeep: that explains it. the q4f quantization / kernel path seems to be emitting a control symbol token in place of comma for some byte pair combos. maybe decoding table mapping got shifted for int4 kernel. :face_with_monocle:

jackie: did this happen with fp16 baseline on same prompts?

maya: no, fp16 baseline produced normal JSON (commas). issue only in quantized runs (q4f/q8_0 tests both show it but q4f higher freq).

sandeep: immediate triage steps: 1) sanitize tool output before JSON parse (strip non-ascii control symbols, replace U+241E with ',') 2) dump full decode table from kernel to verify mapping 3) add nightly assertion to catch non-ASCII separators in function outputs. I'll open a PR for (1).

maya: temp mitigation applied in eval harness: pre-parse sanitizer replaced U+241E and U+241F with "," and re-ran — failures dropped from 32 -> 4, toolcall json errors -> 1.

jackie: nice. pls add failing case to regression test and tag model with `quarantine/q4f-2026-03-19`. we should also notify model-onboarding.

maya: filed issue: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-7621 (includes raw token dump + sample prompts).

ai-runtime: exported kernel decode table and attached to ML-7621. quick look: there is an off-by-one in the decode index for int4 path at boundary between punctuation and control range.

sandeep: probable root cause confirmed. plan: revert to fallback decode table for q4f in serving while we fix kernel mapping. rollout plan: apply fallback for q4f on dedicated/hosted by 03/21.

jackie: owners: sandeep -> implement fallback + PR, maya -> re-run extended nightly after fallback, jackie -> add regression + tag, eval-bot -> monitor nightly for 7 days.

maya: thanks. after fix I'll re-run the full `customer_support_contacts_v2` set and post results here.

sandeep: I'll also add a token-level assert in our function-call parser to log offending token ids rather than just JSON error — will help future triage.

maya: one more note: some outputs also inserted ZERO-WIDTH-NON-JOINER between keys (U+200C) which our sanitizer currently strips but we should consider enforcing ASCII-only for tool outputs.

jackie: agreed. long-term: model onboarding checklist add: run function-call JSON fidelity checks on quantized variants pre-approve.

eval-bot: update posted: ML-7621 created, nightly-eval re-run scheduled.

maya: thanks all — marking this thread solved for now. :white_check_mark:
